overview: Wendy Landier is a Professor in the Department of Pediatrics, Division of Pediatric Hematology/Oncology in the School of Medicine at the University of Alabama at Birmingham. She also serves as Deputy Director of the Institute for Cancer Outcomes and Survivorship at UAB, and holds secondary appointments as Professor in the Department of Surgery and in the School of Nursing.  She is a pediatric nurse practitioner with a clinical focus on the care of childhood cancer survivors. She served as Chair of the Children’s Oncology Group Nursing Discipline from 2011-2020 and now serves as Associate Vice Chair. She was integrally involved in the development of the Children’s Oncology Group Long-Term Follow-Up Guidelines and continues to provide oversight over guideline refinement through her role on the Core Guidelines Committee. Her research focuses on understanding and improving health outcomes in childhood cancer survivors, with an emphasis on secondary cancer prevention; development, implementation, and refinement of guidelines for survivorship care; ototoxicity related to childhood cancer treatment; adherence to therapy; and acquisition of health knowledge by childhood cancer survivors and their parents/caregivers.
